content: Malongi ma Kitsyeni
Mbuta wa banganga Nzambi wuzimbudi: «Buna babati zimbula kikuma kya ngeyi, bwa kyedika bwenina?»
Kitsyeni wávutula: «Baphangi bama yi batata bama hinikinenu! Nzambi wa khembu kádimonikisa kwena Bulahami, tata wetu, tangwa kákala ku Mezophotamiya, hana khaku kenda zakala ku Halani,
amana kámuzimbwala: "Katuka ku tsi yaku yi kikanda kyaku, awenda ku tsi yina yikúsongila."
Hanga wulubuki mu tsi ya bisi Kaditeni, wendi kala ku Halani. Kwakuna, kunima lufwa lwa tata wandi, Nzambi wamuhitisa mu tsi yayi lwisi kala buthwena.
Kámuhekaku keti kuvwa kumosi muna tsi meni yina, keti mafu ma kuthetika bitambi; kaasi kásila ni kamúhekama mafu yi kwena batekulu bandi kinga, muna tangwa meni dina, kákalaku kedi yi mwana.
Nzambi kázonza bwabu: "Kanda dyandi dyakádila mu kinzenza mu tsi ya kinzenza, bakwátadya mu kihika amana banyókunadya mu mvula khama ya.
Kaasi muna tsi yina yabákwata mu kihika, meni yifúndisaya, ku manima ma bwabuna, balúbuka amana bakwata tsambila ha kati dya homa haha."

Kunima Nzambi wáta bulunda yi Bulahami, amana mukhanda wenina kidimbu kya kuyukana; yihana kabutila Yizaki amana wámuyotisa mukhanda mu kilumbu kya nana; bwabuna káhanga Yizaki kwena Yakobi, amana Yakobi phi kwena bana bandi kumi yi bodi, bakhaka ba bikanda byetu.
Bakhaka betu, bana ba Yakobi, bámuyukila kiphala phangi wa bawu Yozefu amana bámutekisa ndangu bamunata ku Ngiphiti. Kaasi Nzambi kákala kumosi yi yandi;
amana wámutabula mu biwayi byandi kyosu, wámuheka phi khenda yi mudimu ku thwala Fwalawo kyamvu wa Ngiphiti, wuna wámuyadika pfumu mu Ngiphiti yi muna nzu yandi yosu
Hanga nzala yifwebuki lawu mu Ngiphiti yosu yi muna tsi ya Kanana. Kiwayi lawu kyákala, amana bakhaka betu bakalaku mona keti kima kya kudya.
Yakobi, buna kayuka ni ngenza za bule zákala mu Ngiphiti, wátuma bakhaka betu mu mbala ya theti.
Amana mu mbala ya zodi
, Yozefu wádizayikisa kwena baphangi bandi, kisina kya Yozefu phi kyázayakana kwena Fwalawo.
Kunima Yozefu wátuma benda musanda tata wandi Yakobi yi kikanda kyandi kyosu; batu makumi tsambwadi yi tanu bákala.
Yakobi wákulumuka ku Ngiphiti. Yi kwakuna káfwila yandi yi bakhaka betu.
Bábanata ku Sikemi amana bábazika muna mazyamu mana kásumba Bulahami yi mbongu kwena bana ba Amoni kuna Sikemi
«Bwosu dyakala bwesuka tangwa dya lusilu luna kásila Nzambi kwena Bulahami, kanda dyávula lawu mu Ngiphiti,
yi kuna tangwa dina kisa yadila kyamvu wahika, mu Ngiphiti, wuna wakonda muzaya Yozefu.
Kyamvu meni wuna kakala huna kanda dyetu mu mayedi mambi, wábanyokuna bakhaka betu, wábadindamisa mu kulosa bana ba bawu ba lubutu ndangu bazingaku.
Muna tangwa meni dina yi mwamuna kábutuka Moyize, wuna wákala kitoku ku mesu ma Nzambi. Kátsatsuka ngonda tatu muna nzu ya tata wandi.
Buna bámuyanika, mwana ndumba wa Fwalawo wámutonguna, amana wámutsasa phi hanga mwana wandi.
Moyize katsasukila muna mudimu wosu za bisi Ngiphiti. Kákala yi hamu dya kuzonza yi muna mihangu myandi.
Buna kalungisa mvula makumaya, wábonga lukanu lwa kwenda kinda biwutu byandi, bisi kiseledi.
Buna kámona mutu mosi bakala yangisa, Moyize wámunwanina amana wávutula mbela ya mutu wuna bánwanisa; wámuhondyanga mwisi Ngiphiti.
Kabanza ni biwutu byandi babákula ni Nzambi wuzodi kabaheka luhulusu mu nzila ya yandi; kaasi bábakulabwoku.
Kilumbu kyalanda, wádimonikisa kwena bana bákala nwana, wuzodi ni kavutula ngemba ha kati kya bawu mu kuzimbula: "Lwenina baphangi, biki lubati nwanina benu yi benu?"
Kaasi wuna wakala yangisa mukwawu, hanga wumununguni Moyize amana wuzimbudi: "Nati wukusi pfumu yi zusi kwena betu?
Wuzodi waphonda bwosu wuhondiki mukolu mwisi Ngiphiti?"
Buna káyuka bwabuna, Moyize watina, wenda mu kinzenza muna tsi ya Madyani. Kwakuna, wabuta bana ba bayakala bodi.
«Buna zalunga mvula makumaya, wanzyo mosi wámumonikina, muna nganga yina ya mongu wa Sinayi, muna muleku wa mbawu hana kivunza.
Mu kumona bwabuna, Moyize wáyituka kikuma kya mbona mesu yina. Amana bwosu kakala bwesuka mu kutala, ndinga ya Pfumu yáyukalakana:
"Meni yenina Nzambi wa bakhaka baku, Bulahami, Yizaki yi Yakobi". Moyize kuna yi tsula, kálendaku mu kutala.
Pfumu wumuzimbwadi: "Womuna tsabatu
zaku, mukuma homa haka wutelamiki, mena mafu matoma.
Mboni phasi za kanda dyama dyenina mu Ngiphiti, ngyuki bibimu bya bawu, khulumukini ndangu yibahulula. Buthwena awisa, yikútuma ku Ngiphiti."
«Moyize yandu básuwangana, mu kuzimbula: "Nati wukuyadikini pfumu yi zusi?", yandi wuna kátuma Nzambi hanga pfumu yi muhuludi
, mu lusadisu lwa wanzyo wuna wámulubwakila ha kivunza kya mbawu.
Yandi wábalubula, wásala phi biphadi yi bidimbu bya phila yi phila mu tsi ya Ngiphiti, ku yanga dya Kabengi yi mu nganga, mu mvula makumaya.
Moyize meni wuna wázimbula kwena bisi Kiseledi: "Nzambi kalúhitika hana kati dya baphangi benu, mbikudi mosi hanga meni.
Mu lukutakanu, yandi wákala hakimosi yi wanzyo wuna wakala muzonzila ha mongu wa Sinayi yi bakhaka betu; kátambula ndinga za luzingu ndangu katuhekaza.
Bakhaka betu bábwisa kumulemvukila; kaasi bámusuwangana, yi sunga dya kuvutuka ku Ngiphiti.
Bazimbudi kwena Loni: "Tuyidikila banzambi bana bakala kwenda ku thwala betu, mukuma Moyize meni wawuna wátulubula mu tsi ya Ngiphiti, tuzayiku mana mamubwidi."
Muna bilumbu meni bina, báhala nzambi wa kiteki kya mwana wa ngombi, bámunatina phi mukhayilu wumosi amana báta mukinzi yi kihangwa kya moku ma bawu.
Kaasi Nzambi wábafwila kunda, wábayambula ni bafukamina bihangwa bya ku zilu, bwosu básonika mu mikanda mya bambikudi:

content.text: Loni, kaasi sombolu dya nzambi wenu wa kiteki Moloki
yi katumbwa ka nzambi wenu wa kiteki Lefwani
bifwanisu meni bina lwáhala mu kubafukamina.
Ihana ni yisenda ni balunata kyana kuluta mbanza ya Babiloni."»

content: «Muna nganga, bakhaka betu, bákala yi sombolu dya kimbangi, hanga dina kásongila Nzambi wuna wázonza kwena Moyize ni kayidika, bwosu kifwanisu kina kámona.

Sombolu meni dina báhanadya kwena bakhaka betu bana bálanda ku manima yi Yosuwe bákotisadya muna tsi ya makanda mana kákukwasa Nzambi ku thwala ya bawu. Dyásala hana tii yi kuna tangwa dya Tavidi.
Tavidi wámona khenda za Nzambi amana wálomba homa hamosi ndangu katungila nzu kikuma kya Nzambi wa Yakobi.
Kaasi Salomoni wámutungisila nzu.
Kaasi Kahungu kisiku zingila mu nzu zina bátunga mu moku ma batu. Bwosu kazonza mbikudi:

content.text: amana mafu menina kidyatilu kya bitambi byama.
Ka koku dyama ku dyáhanga mana moosu?"

content: «Benu batu ba mutwa ngolu yi mbundu za matadi yi bizika matu, lwisi bwisa kaka Kitembu Kyatoma! Lwenina hanga bakhaka benu.
Khi mbikudi bákonda nyokuna bakhaka benu? Báhonda bana batekila samuna kukwisa kwa mutu wa masonga; wuna lwalambudi, buthwena, benu amana lumuhondi.
Benu lwátambula mitsiku mina báluheka banzyo kaasi, lwázitisamyoku!»
Lufwa lwa Kitsyeni
Buna bayuka mambu mana, bafunga khabu yi kukwekisaka menu kikuma kya Kitsyeni.
Kaasi yandi, wabasa yi Kitembu kyatoma, buna katala ku zilu, wámona khembu ya Nzambi; amana Yesu watelama kuna koku dya kitata dya Nzambi.
Wuzimbudi: «Mbati mona zilu dya kukangula yi Mwana wa mutu watelema kuna koku dya kitata dya Nzambi.»
Hanga bakalungi ngolu, baziki matu ma bawu, boosu bamubwidi;
bámubulumuna ku phenza ya mbanza amana báyandika kumuta matadi. Bambangi básisa miledi mya bawu kwena ngunza mosi, bakala tela Sawulu ndangu kasimbululakamya.
Kuna yi kumutimbwalaka matadi, Kitsyeni kakala lombila mu kuzimbula: «Pfumu Yesu, yamba moya wama!»
Kunima wábwa muna makungulu amana wákalunga: «Pfumu, wubafutisaku disumu dyadi!» Buna kázimbula bwabuna, wátabula.

footnotes.text: "Pfumu mu Ngiphiti" disongidila ni Yozefu kakala yala bisi Ngiphiti. "Nzu yandi yosu" hangambe ti bima byosu bina byákala mu nzu Fwalawo. Yozefu wásenda kwena batu boosu mu kulumbika ngenza mu mvula tsambwadi. Kunima wátekisa ngenza zina bálubula batu mu khila.
Kuy 42-45 mwamuna babati zonzila yi tsikiningi mbala meni zina zodi benda bana ba bayakala ba Yakobi mu Ngiphiti mu kusumba ngenza za bule.

Batu ba Kitsyeni bakala zayila ni muna mafu mana kásumba Bulahami yi mbongu, mwamuna bámuzika Yakobi (Kuy 50:13) amana bahika ni ku Sikemi bázika mifufwa myandi (Yos 24:32). Batu bahika bázimbula ni baphangi ba Yozefu ku Sikemi bábazikila, kaasi muyuta mosi wálonguka mambu mana máluta, khumbu yandi Yosefwati, kázimbula ni ku Heboni bábazika. Fwani bwakala ni batu babazika baphangi ba Yozefu bela-bela yi Heboni holo ku Sikemi.
Nzambi kámusenda Moyize mu kuwomuna tsabatu zandi kikuma kya kuta kimbangi kya luzitu.

Kitsyeni kámuzonzila Moyize hanga muhuludi, mu kusadila muhowu wumosi yi wuna kázonzila mu khaphu ya 7:27b. Muhowu meni wuna wa muhuludi, wawuna phi kásadila Luka mu mambu matadidi Yesu muna Mukanda wa Luk 24:21. Disongidila ni mutu mosi wubati lubula batu ku mambu ma phasi mu kufuta thalu ya lawu ndangu kabonga kiphwanza kya bawu. Tuzayi, konda keti-keti ni Kitsyeni wámufwanikisa Moyize yi Yesu. Bwosu káhitisa Moyize luzingu lwandi ndangu bisi Kiseledi balubuka mu kihika kya bawu, bwabuna phi kálambula Pfumu Yesu luzingu lwandi mu kulubula batu mu kihika ndangu Nzambi kabahekaku ndola kikuma kya masumu ma bawu.
Moloki: khumbu ya nzambi wa zilu yi tangwa wuna bakala fukamina kwena bisi Kana yi bisi Fenisi. Muna kati dya sombolu mwakala yi nzambi wa kiteki mosi wuna wakala hanga nzambi wa bawu.

Katumbwa kabati songila kidimbu kimosi kondilo nzambi wa kiteki wuna bakala nata bisi Kiseledi. Lefwani: khumbu ya katumbwa, yibati songila tsi ya Satudine yina bakala fukamina hanga pfumu kwena bisi Ngiphiti yi bisi Kiseledi bahika.
